_about: Water (1) + cyclohexane (2): solubility of cyclohexane in liquid water (water-rich liquid of the liquid-liquid equilibrium), 343-424 K at 1700 kPa, from Marche et al. (2003). Rows: temperature in K, mole fraction of cyclohexane in the water-rich liquid.

source.citation: C. Marche, H. Delepine, C. Ferronato, J. Jose, An apparatus for the on-line GC determination of hydrocarbon solubility in water: benzene and cyclohexane from 70 C to 150 C, J. Chem. Eng. Data 48 (2003) 398-401
source.access: Journal article is subscription-only; the same data is public in the NIST TRC ThermoML Archive (NIST open license).
source.tables: ThermoML record, PureOrMixtureData 2: cyclohexane + water, mole fraction of cyclohexane in liquid mixture 1 (the water-rich liquid), constraint P = 1700 kPa. The table number in the article was not checked (article not open).

notes: Liquid I is the water-rich liquid, liquid II the cyclohexane-rich liquid; x_1 is the mole fraction of water, x_2 of cyclohexane. Only the water-rich liquid was measured, at 1700 kPa (the pressure effect on the liquid solubility is not modelled). Two rows at 373.25 K are repeat measurements, both kept. Expanded uncertainties in the record: 2e-07 to 4e-06. Values as stored in the ThermoML record (XML file), extracted with validation/python/thermoml_read.py; nothing converted or rounded. To be checked by a person against the record before use (AGENTS.md rule 4).
